# Border drag resizing (C5.4): tmux 3.8's MouseDrag1Border (resize-pane -M) moves the borders
# under the drag as on tmux; pane sizes and frames after each drag are compared. "run run-shell
# -d 0.4" waits out the click timeout between drags.
size 80x24
run new-session -d -s a 'exec cat' ; split-window -h -l 40 -t a 'exec cat' ; split-window -v -t a:0.1 'exec cat'
client c 80x24
run list-panes -t a -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}@#{pane_left},#{pane_top}'
# The vertical border at column 39, to the right and back left past the middle.
type c '\x1b[<0;40;5M'
type c '\x1b[<32;45;5M'
type c '\x1b[<32;50;5M'
type c '\x1b[<0;50;5m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
run list-panes -t a -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}@#{pane_left},#{pane_top}'
type c '\x1b[<0;50;5M'
type c '\x1b[<32;30;5M'
type c '\x1b[<0;30;5m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
run list-panes -t a -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}@#{pane_left},#{pane_top}'
# The horizontal border between the right panes, down then up.
type c '\x1b[<0;60;12M'
type c '\x1b[<32;60;16M'
type c '\x1b[<0;60;16m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
run list-panes -t a -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}@#{pane_left},#{pane_top}'
screen c
# The corner where both meet moves both borders.
type c '\x1b[<0;30;16M'
type c '\x1b[<32;36;10M'
type c '\x1b[<0;36;10m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
run list-panes -t a -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}@#{pane_left},#{pane_top}'
# Past the edge: panes keep their minimum size.
type c '\x1b[<0;36;5M'
type c '\x1b[<32;1;5M'
type c '\x1b[<0;1;5m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
run list-panes -t a -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}@#{pane_left},#{pane_top}'
# A drag that starts in a pane resizes nothing.
type c '\x1b[<0;20;5M'
type c '\x1b[<32;25;8M'
type c '\x1b[<0;25;8m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
run list-panes -t a -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}@#{pane_left},#{pane_top}'
# With two status lines at the top and pane border status lines, as i-mux sets them.
run new-window -t a -n t2 'exec cat' ; split-window -h -l 52 -t a:t2 'exec cat' ; split-window -h -l 26 -t a:t2.1 'exec cat'
run select-pane -t a:t2.0 -T p0 ; select-pane -t a:t2.1 -T p1 ; select-pane -t a:t2.2 -T p2 ; select-pane -t a:t2.0
run set -g status 2 ; set -g status-position top ; set -g pane-border-status top ; set -g status-right R
run list-panes -t a -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}@#{pane_left},#{pane_top}'
type c '\x1b[<0;28;10M'
type c '\x1b[<32;20;10M'
type c '\x1b[<0;20;10m'
run run-shell -d 0.4
run list-panes -t a -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}@#{pane_left},#{pane_top}'
screen c
run kill-server
